BTCUSDT 1d · every pivot · 1% benchmark

890 pivots. Low = BUY research point; high = SELL research point. Blue: 1% HIT. Orange: complete NO_HIT. Missing/censored cases remain separate in JSON.

This is retrospective research. Offset 0 is the actual pivot candle, scored using its close. Positive offsets contain later information. They are not inputs to a prediction at the pivot. Means can hide multiple patterns; no rules are automatically selected.
